title: FIRST-USER:155
text: - **Steering upkeep:** put the matching standing instruction in the project's steering guidance/CURRENT-PLAN so itemless steering receives it too: consult the prototype, review reported gaps, link them to existing work or file follow-ups, and maintain planned coverage. Recording a gap does not complete its teaching. Reuse existing reporting and intake; add no new deterministic upkeep-enforcement system. Later access failures record the specific pending update rather than silently claiming it happened.
